title: Critical RUL Exhaustion & Immediate Aircraft On Ground (AOG) Overhaul Protocol

telemetry_indicators.estimated_rul: Remaining Useful Life estimated at under 20 operating cycles
telemetry_indicators.compound_anomalies: Simultaneous divergent readings in both compressor pressure (S11) and turbine temperature (S4)

root_causes: Run-to-failure end-of-life component degradation across multiple thermal-mechanical stages
High probability of in-flight shutdown (IFSD) or uncontained failure if operated without major shop visit
dispatch_protocol: REVOKE ETOPS AND FLIGHT CLEARANCE IMMEDIATELY. Ferry flight to certified MRO overhaul facility only.
inspection_procedure: Step 1: Ground powerplant immediately upon landing; log engine serial number into AOG priority registry.
Step 2: Quarantine oil filter and chip detector plugs for spectrometric oil analysis (SOAP).
Step 3: Disconnect quick engine change (QEC) harness and prepare engine for removal from pylon.
Step 4: Dispatch engine to FAA/EASA Part 145 overhaul depot for complete core module disassembly.
safety_advisories: Mandatory red-tag engine control switch. Do not attempt high-power ground run.
